name: P15 + P29 + P31 — the battle scene, the transitions and the encounters, in the real world

steps.note: 1. Puddlewick Vale, before anything happens. The fight will be staged on THIS ground.

steps.msg: the meadow walks on the field encounter table, from the Long Lane
80 free paces on arriving somewhere new (SYSTEMS 9)
the threshold is a triangular draw between 22 and 62 paces

steps.note: 2. Walk. The step counter fills, the DQ swirl spirals in, and the fight is on the lane you were standing on.

steps.msg: the backdrop is the map itself — no loading, no painted flat
the DQ command window, bottom-left
only Bram takes commands; the rest fight by their Tactics

steps.note: 3. One press picks Fight, one picks the target: the gold cursor hops onto the monster it is on.
4. Tactics: who fights how, free, mid-battle.

steps.msg: the swing landed and the log says so

steps.note: 5. Watch the rest of it, then the victory tally, and back to the field on the exact spot you left.

steps.msg: the field comes back, same map
60 free paces after a battle
the fight was written into the party

steps.note: 6. The level-up ceremony: the panel slides in, the gains reveal one at a time, then the spell card.

steps.msg: the gains reveal one at a time, not as a wall of text
a newly learnt spell gets a card of its own

steps.note: 7. The signature beat: a monster asks to join. (Twelve misses guarantee the thirteenth asks — MONSTER 7.)

steps.msg: the question is the last thing on screen: Yes / No
no level-up text types over the question
the new friend rides in the wagon
…and fights wisely on its own

steps.note: 8. A boss door: it asks first, it never just happens to you. Then the telegraph — a red chevron and a warning.

steps.msg: the boss door asks Yes / No

steps.eval: (window.__tel = (() => { const keep = __DQ.rosterSnapshot(); __DQ.instant(true); for (let seed = 1; seed < 90; seed++) { __DQ.rosterRestore(keep); __DQ.fight('cobwell_manor', {boss: true, level: 7, seed}); for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); if (__DQ.state().battle.enemies.some(e => e.telegraphing)) { __DQ.instant(false); __DQ.rosterRestore(keep); return seed; } } } __DQ.instant(false); __DQ.rosterRestore(keep); return -1; })())

(() => { for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); if (__DQ.state().battle.enemies.some(e => e.telegraphing)) break; } return 'wound up'; })()

steps.msg: the boss winds its Big Attack up a whole round in advance
…and a red chevron pulses over its head

steps.note: 9. Losing is gentle: fade to WHITE, wake at the chapel of Saint Alden, half the gold with a floor of 30, and one sentence a child can act on.

steps.msg: you wake at the church, not where you fell
the gold floor: never less than 30
the wipe says one thing a child can act on
everybody is mended, free
the words Game Over appear nowhere

steps.note: 10. Two wipes in a row, and the unhurried woman with the basket is at the door on the third approach.

steps.msg: she heals you and hands over three Strong Herbs, and never says why she is there
three Strong Herbs really are in the bag

steps.note: 11. The wipes themselves: the swirl, the door fade, the flash, the iris.

steps.msg: the fade carried you into the next map
the transitions layer is live and settled
no runtime errors
